lenses.name: Brownfield sites
lenses.description: Cartofriches brownfield inventory sites per 100 km². Coverage comes from heterogeneous local inventories, so low values may reflect missing inventories rather than a true absence of brownfields.

lenses.name: Brownfield land
lenses.description: Cartofriches brownfield-site cadastral surface as a share of land. Inventory surfaces can overlap or include very large industrial estates, so local shares can exceed parcel-scale intuition and are not a complete national brownfield-cadastre measurement.

lenses.name: Brownfields without projects
lenses.description: Cartofriches brownfield-site surface whose inventory status is 'friche sans projet', as a share of land. This reuse-potential indicator depends on locally reported project status.
